Cinematic oner, third-person chase camera, steadicam fluidity, photorealistic, ultra-high-definition, hyperdetailed, 35mm film quality, professional color grading, sharp focus, high detail texture, subtle film grain, depth of field mastery. Aspect ratio 16:9.A lone rider cuts through a violent arctic storm above a frozen fjord canyon. The rider is a compact figure in layered polar flight gear, frost-lined goggles, fur-lined collar, and a torn white wind shell pressed low against the mount's neck, gloved hands locked on a leather harness.The mount is an original creature design, not a dragon: a sleek frost-glider with a long manta-like body, raptor shoulders, and translucent wing membranes edged with crystalline ice ridges. Pale gold vein-light pulses along its wing seams and throat, the only warmth in a frozen steel-blue world. No scales, no fire breath, no classic dragon silhouette.The storm is brutal and cold: slate-grey thunderheads, sideways sleet, black cloud canyons, lightning tearing across hanging glaciers and sheer ice walls. Snow streaks horizontally past the lens.Flight choreography for one unbroken 5-second arc:Second 0–1: The camera chases low and tight behind the rider as the frost-glider banks hard between two ice pillars, wing edges slicing spray from the storm.Second 1–2.5: It whips around to the side, tearing through a curtain of driving snow, lightning flashing behind the rider's silhouette, the pale gold wing-light cutting through blue murk.Second 2.5–4: Without warning, a colossal ice-ridge serpent erupts head-on from a wall of fog and shattered spindrift directly ahead. Time violently ramps into extreme slow motion. At near-standstill, the giant's frost-crusted head fills the frame, one enormous pale-gold eye reflecting the tiny rider, breath steaming, ice crystals and snowflakes hanging frozen in the air, horizontal anamorphic flares raking the lens.Second 4–5: Reality snaps back to full speed. The frost-glider rolls hard beneath the serpent's jaw and dives into a narrow ice ravine, the camera surging after it as fog and snow swallow the frame.[VFX: pale gold vein bioluminescence, colossal ice serpent, volumetric storm fog, lightning, suspended ice particles in slow motion]Epic, cinematic, photoreal, fluid, uninterrupted. No text, no logos, no dialogue. No traditional dragon, no dragon-versus-dragon confrontation, no castle, no fantasy army.

[Segment 1]
Style: dream physics, deep-blue monochrome with a misty diffusion in the glow, shadows keeping faint layers instead of pure black, spatial scale distortion, photoreal texture.
Action: [0s-1.5s] The projected face breathes with light shifts, dust drifting, his silhouette still; [1.5s-4s] The camera pulls back slowly and the giant face shrinks with it, revealing that this colossal face floats on the wall of a vast bedroom: a projection inside a dream-room, his silhouette standing at the bedside looking up; [4s-8s] The camera keeps pulling back past the room's boundary as the walls curl inward like paper, folding into the darkness of a second dream layer, the giant face shrinking with the curling walls into a floating glowing mask suspended in the void, the man motionless and looking up throughout, the frame ending with the mask hovering directly above him. No text. Camera: one continuous pull-back, slight warping as the space folds, no cuts. Audio: a low drone wrapped in an underwater-feeling muted reverb, paper-like stretching as the space curls, one distant bell.

[Segment 2]
Style: same dreamy haze, the blue one shade darker, a deeper dream layer.
Action: [0s-2s] The glowing mask rotates slowly above him; he raises a hand, and the instant his fingertips near it the whole space collapses in scale: the mask becomes a reflection inside a pupil, his body edge receding into silhouette; [2s-5s] The viewpoint reveals itself as his eye all along: the frame wavers slightly, we have been looking through his pupil, the blue iris texture rings into view at the frame's edge; [5s-8s] The giant face in the pupil breathes once with light, the dream begins to dissolve: the image tears slightly like a bad signal, the reflection flickers twice, locking finally on the extreme eye close-up, a deeper blue surfacing slowly in the depths of the iris. No text. Camera: an objective view snapping into pupil-POV, the switch made through a slight signal-tear, no cuts. Audio: a heartbeat approaching to become the main beat, one falling bass note as the mask shrinks, signal noise through the tear, every sound sucked away on the last beat leaving a faint ringing in the ears.

[Shared]
Dreamy haze over the blue monochrome, faint layers in the shadows, photoreal texture, spatial scale distorting with each dream layer. Negative: no water ripples, no third-person frontal face, no color shift away from the blue monochrome, no text overlays, no subtitles, no dissolve transitions, no extra light sources, no logo.

## How this graph is wired

This is a MiniMax H3 Max **first-last-frame to video** template. It has **one required path** and **two optional stages**. You choose whether to run the optional stages. Both start **off**.

On the canvas, two nodes are marked **red**. Those are **Switch** nodes. Each is the on/off gate for an optional stage, driven by a boolean in the **Feature Flags** group.

### 1. Video generation (required)

**MiniMax H3 First-Last-Frame to Video** is the core. It always runs. Feed it **Text (Prompt)**, **Load Image (First Frame)**, and **Load Image (Last Frame)**. The first **Save Video** is the first-pass output.

### 2. Prompt enhance (optional)

**Boolean (Prompt Enhance)** feeds the red **Switch** in **Prompt Enhancer (Optional)**.

- Set it to `true` to rewrite the prompt with **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)** before generation.
- Leave it `false` to send your raw prompt straight to video generation.

### 3. Video upscale (optional)

**Boolean (Upscale to 2K)** feeds the red **Switch** in **Upscale Video to 2K (Optional)**.

- Set it to `true` to run **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K** on the first-pass video.
- Leave it `false` to save the first-pass video as-is.

Upscale **only accepts 768P** source video. If you turn this stage on, generate at **768P**. Other resolutions are not supported by **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K**.

You can enable section 2, section 3, both, or neither.

### Duration must match

Keep **duration** the same on every MiniMax node you actually use (generation, prompt enhance, and upscale). The clip length must match across those stages. If one node is 5s and another is 6s, enhance or upscale will be out of sync with the generated video.

### Extra inputs must be duplicated

The generate node, the prompt-enhance node, and the upscale node do **not** share extra context automatically.

**Load Image (First Frame)** and **Load Image (Last Frame)** are already wired into generation. If you turn on prompt enhance or upscale, **also plug those same two images** (and any other extra inputs you add: another image, a reference video, audio) into:

- **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)**, so prompt enhance sees the same frames and references
- **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K**, so upscale sees the same frames and references

If you only wire extras into generation, enhance and upscale will run without that context and the result will drift.

## How this graph is wired

This is a MiniMax H3 Max **image-to-video** template (first / last frame), not the multi-reference graph. It has **one required path** and **two optional stages**. You choose whether to run the optional stages. Both start **off**.

On the canvas, two nodes are marked **red**. Those are **Switch** nodes. Each is the on/off gate for an optional stage, driven by a boolean in the **Feature Flags** group.

### 1. Video generation (required)

**MiniMax H3 First-Last-Frame to Video** is the core. It always runs. Feed it **Text (Prompt)** and a first-frame image from **Load Image**. Last frame is optional. The first **Save Video** is the first-pass output.

### 2. Prompt enhance (optional)

**Boolean (Prompt Enhance)** feeds the red **Switch** in **Prompt Enhancer (Optional)**.

- Set it to `true` to rewrite the prompt with **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)** before generation.
- Leave it `false` to send your raw prompt straight to video generation.

### 3. Video upscale (optional)

**Boolean (Upscale to 2K)** feeds the red **Switch** in **Upscale Video to 2K (Optional)**.

- Set it to `true` to run **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K** on the first-pass video.
- Leave it `false` to save the first-pass video as-is.

Upscale **only accepts 768P** source video. If you turn this stage on, generate at **768P**. Other resolutions are not supported by **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K**.

You can enable section 2, section 3, both, or neither.

### Duration must match

Keep **duration** the same on every MiniMax node you actually use (generation, prompt enhance, and upscale). The clip length must match across those stages. If one node is 5s and another is 6s, enhance or upscale will be out of sync with the generated video.

### Extra inputs must be duplicated

The generate node, the prompt-enhance node, and the upscale node do **not** share extra context automatically.

The first-frame image is already wired into all three. If you add more inputs (a last frame, another image, a reference video, audio, or any extra output you plug into generation), **also plug the same wires into**:

- **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)**, so prompt enhance sees the same frames and references
- **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K**, so upscale sees the same frames and references

If you only wire extras into generation, enhance and upscale will run without that context and the result will drift.

A glowing cyan food box is strapped to the back seat. The wheels raise twin walls of heavy spray, and the initial burst inflates his poncho like a sail, while the red-orange signage streaks into glowing light trails on both sides. On the left, oversized cyan text "STEEP CITY" shatters into rain-particle fragments upon the bike's impact. Overhead, a light-rail train thunders out through the waist of the building at extreme speed, its illuminated light band strobing intensely across the rider's wet translucent poncho. The rider ducks low over the handlebars and accelerates head-on, braiding the two extreme speeds into one. Glitchy white text "RAIN CITY" flashes character by character in sync with the rail's light band. [Shot 3] At 00:01.400, the camera cuts to a medium Pull Out shot as the rider and e-bike from Shot 1 launch into the air off the top of a steep stone stair flight. Mid-air, the glowing food box's lid pops open a crack, revealing metallic containers glinting inside, while the cyan rain curtain behind him stretches into vertical light filaments. Upon landing, the front wheel bites heavily into the accumulated water, plowing a massive V-shaped wake as the rider continues without pausing. In the foreground, ice-blue text "I CLIMB" is torn into a displaced motion trail by the intense landing spray. Crisscrossing streaks of traffic lights beam between the massive pillars as the rider darts left and right, maneuvering through the bright gaps in the crossing light. widgets_values:
## How this graph is wired

This is a MiniMax H3 Max **text-to-video** template. It has **one required path** and **two optional stages**. You choose whether to run the optional stages. Both start **off**.

On the canvas, two nodes are marked **red**. Those are **Switch** nodes. Each is the on/off gate for an optional stage, driven by a boolean in the **Feature Flags** group.

### 1. Video generation (required)

**MiniMax H3 Text to Video** is the core. It always runs. Feed it **Text (Prompt)**. The first **Save Video** is the first-pass output.

### 2. Prompt enhance (optional)

**Boolean (Prompt Enhance)** feeds the red **Switch** in **Prompt Enhancer (Optional)**.

- Set it to `true` to rewrite the prompt with **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)** before generation.
- Leave it `false` to send your raw prompt straight to video generation.

### 3. Video upscale (optional)

**Boolean (Upscale to 2K)** feeds the red **Switch** in **Upscale Video to 2K (Optional)**.

- Set it to `true` to run **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K** on the first-pass video.
- Leave it `false` to save the first-pass video as-is.

Upscale **only accepts 768P** source video. If you turn this stage on, generate at **768P**. Other resolutions are not supported by **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K**.

You can enable section 2, section 3, both, or neither.

### Duration must match

Keep **duration** the same on every MiniMax node you actually use (generation, prompt enhance, and upscale). The clip length must match across those stages. If one node is 5s and another is 6s, enhance or upscale will be out of sync with the generated video.

### Extra inputs must be duplicated

The generate node is text-only. **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)** and **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K** still accept extra context (first/last frame, extra images, reference video, audio).

Those two optional nodes do **not** share extra context automatically. If you add extra input nodes and turn on prompt enhance or upscale, **plug the same wires into both**:

- **MiniMax H3 Context IR (Prompt Enhancer)**, so prompt enhance sees that context
- **MiniMax H3 Regenerate to 2K**, so upscale sees that context

If you only wire extras into one of them, the other stage will run without that context and the result will drift.
